beats.care: Live near JP Nagar, BTM, Hulimavu or Uttarahalli? You may get a bus straight to the metro, with live arrival times.
beats.what: BMTC plans 5 feeder routes with 30 buses making 415 trips a day to the soon-to-open Pink Line metro stations.
beats.why: Metro only helps if you can reach the station. Feeder buses cover the last few km from homes to stations.

cards.body: 30 buses across 5 routes, about every 10 minutes, as per BMTC's plan.
cards.caption: daily trips planned

cards.body: MF-18J: Jayadeva Hospital–Uttarahalli. MF-18JT: Jayadeva–Tavarekere. MF-18JP: JP Nagar 4th Phase–IIMB ring. MF-22HS: Hulimavu–Singasandra via Begur Lake. MF-18T: Tavarekere ring via Jayanagar and Banashankari.
Fares and a start date aren't out yet. BMTC says routes are subject to final operational arrangements.

cards.q: Would a feeder bus get you onto the metro?

opts: Getting from home to the metro station
cards.q: What problem do feeder buses mainly solve?
cards.why: Feeders cover the last-mile gap between neighbourhoods and stations, so more people can use the metro.

hook: Pink Line feeder buses every *10 minutes*. Is your area listed?

learn.t: BMTC already runs 71 metro feeder services covering 54 stations across the city.

sources.name: Deccan Herald
sources.title: BMTC to launch 5 dedicated feeder buses for Pink Line metro stations

tldr: BMTC will run 5 new feeder bus routes linking south Bengaluru neighbourhoods to the upcoming Pink Line metro stations.
